_comment: Feats (Player's Handbook 2024, chapter 5). category: origin (from a background, or a human's Versatile), general, fighting_style, epic. trait: the data/traits.json definition that does what it does in a fight (kernel hooks and modifiers). choices: picked when the feat is taken (rules/feats.py; a background may fix some, as Magic Initiate (Cleric) fixes the list): kind skill, skill_or_tool, tool (from a group in rules/feats.py TOOL_GROUPS), spell_list, cantrip, spell (level), ability. upgrade_in: the expansion that brings the rest of it. prerequisite: {level, abilities (any one of them at least), training (armour kind), spellcasting, style (the Fighting Style feature)}. Kinds increase (+1 to an ability, at most 20), damage_type, skill_or_expertise, expertise. gives: armour and weapon training, tools, a save (the raised ability). spells: cast once a long rest without a slot (as Magic Initiate's). suggest: what the Auto and Suggest take at an ability increase, by the kind of fighter (rules/feats.archetype).

alert.name: Alert
alert.text: Always ready: your proficiency bonus is added to your initiative.

crafter.name: Crafter
crafter.text: Proficiency with three kinds of artisan's tools, and a fifth off the price of anything plain you buy in a shop.

healer.name: Healer
healer.text: Battle Medic: with a healer's kit and an action, a friend beside you spends a Hit Die and heals it and your proficiency bonus. Healing dice that come up 1 are rolled again.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.text: Luck points equal to your proficiency bonus, back after a long rest: a missed attack or a failed saving throw is rolled again (the better kept).

magic_initiate.name: Magic Initiate
magic_initiate.text: Two cantrips and one level 1 spell of the cleric's, the druid's or the wizard's lists; the spell is cast once a long rest without a slot.

musician.name: Musician
musician.text: Proficiency with three musical instruments; after a rest, a song gives Heroic Inspiration to as many companions as your proficiency bonus.

savage_attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage_attacker.text: Once a turn, when you hit with a weapon, its damage dice are rolled twice and the higher kept.

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.text: Proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice.

tavern_brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavern_brawler.text: Your fists hit for 1d4 + Strength, and a 1 on their damage is rolled again; you are proficient with improvised weapons; once a turn a punch can shove the one you hit 5 feet away.

tough.name: Tough
tough.text: Two more hit points at every level.

actor.name: Actor
actor.text: +1 Charisma. In a disguise you play the part well: the watch and the curious find it hard to see through you. You can mimic voices and the calls of beasts.

athlete.name: Athlete
athlete.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. You climb as fast as you walk, get up from the ground with only 5 feet of movement, and make a running leap after only 5 feet of run.

charger.name: Charger
charger.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. A Dash carries you 10 feet further. Once a turn, after running at least 10 feet straight at a foe, a melee hit deals 1d8 more damage or drives them 10 feet back.

chef.name: Chef
chef.text: +1 Constitution or Wisdom, and cook's utensils. A meal you cook at a short rest gives an extra 1d8 to everyone who spends Hit Dice. After a long rest you have treats (your proficiency bonus of them): eaten as a bonus action, each gives temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

crossbow_expert.name: Crossbow Expert
crossbow_expert.text: +1 Dexterity. Crossbows never need a free hand to load (no Loading), a foe beside you does not spoil your shot with one, and a hand crossbow's off-hand shot adds your Dexterity to its damage.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.text: +1 Strength or Constitution. Once a turn a bludgeoning hit can shove the foe 5 feet. A bludgeoning critical hit leaves them reeling: every attack against them has advantage until your next turn.

defensive_duelist.name: Defensive Duelist
defensive_duelist.text: +1 Dexterity. Holding a finesse weapon, when a melee blow would hit you, your reaction parries it: your proficiency bonus to your AC against melee blows until your next turn.

dual_wielder.name: Dual Wielder
dual_wielder.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. After attacking with a light weapon, your bonus action strikes with the other hand's weapon even if it is not light (any one-handed melee weapon).

durable.name: Durable
durable.text: +1 Constitution. Advantage on death saving throws, and as a bonus action you can spend a Hit Die to heal what it rolls.

elemental_adept.name: Elemental Adept
elemental_adept.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Your spells of one element (acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder) ignore resistance to it, and a 1 on their damage dice counts as a 2.

fey_touched.name: Fey Touched
fey_touched.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. The fey's touch teaches you Misty Step and one level 1 spell of divination or enchantment, each cast once a long rest without a slot.

grappler.name: Grappler
grappler.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Once a turn a punch can both hurt and grab. You have advantage on attacks against anyone you hold, and dragging them costs you no extra movement.

great_weapon_master.name: Great Weapon Master
great_weapon_master.text: +1 Strength. A hit with a heavy weapon deals your proficiency bonus in extra damage. When a melee weapon scores a critical hit or drops a foe, your bonus action strikes again with it.

heavily_armored.name: Heavily Armored
heavily_armored.text: +1 Constitution or Strength, and training with heavy armour.

heavy_armor_master.name: Heavy Armor Master
heavy_armor_master.text: +1 Constitution or Strength. In heavy armour, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage you take is reduced by your proficiency bonus.

inspiring_leader.name: Inspiring Leader
inspiring_leader.text: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. After a short or long rest your words steel up to six companions: temporary hit points equal to your level plus the raised ability's modifier.

keen_mind.name: Keen Mind
keen_mind.text: +1 Intelligence. Proficiency in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion (expertise if you have it already), and you Study a foe with a bonus action.

lightly_armored.name: Lightly Armored
lightly_armored.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity, and training with light armour and shields.

mage_slayer.name: Mage Slayer
mage_slayer.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. A caster you hurt keeps a spell going only with disadvantage on the save. Once between rests, a failed Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save of yours can be turned into a success.

martial_weapon_training.name: Martial Weapon Training
martial_weapon_training.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity, and proficiency with martial weapons.

medium_armor_master.name: Medium Armor Master
medium_armor_master.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Medium armour lets up to 3 of your Dexterity into your AC instead of 2.

moderately_armored.name: Moderately Armored
moderately_armored.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity, and training with medium armour and shields.

mounted_combatant.name: Mounted Combatant
mounted_combatant.text: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Wisdom. You ride well: your mount keeps its footing and you strike well from the saddle (mounted fighting comes in full with a later expansion).

observant.name: Observant
observant.text: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Proficiency in one of Insight, Investigation or Perception (expertise if you have it already), and you Search with a bonus action.

piercer.name: Piercer
piercer.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Once a turn, a piercing hit rolls its lowest damage die again (the new roll kept). A piercing critical hit adds one more damage die.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.text: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence, and a poisoner's kit. Poison you deal ignores resistance to it (brewing your own poisons comes with a later expansion).

polearm_master.name: Polearm Master
polearm_master.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. After attacking with a quarterstaff, spear or polearm, your bonus action strikes with its butt end (1d4 bludgeoning). Your reaction strikes anyone who steps into your reach.

resilient.name: Resilient
resilient.text: +1 to an ability you are not yet trained to resist with, and proficiency in its saving throws.

ritual_caster.name: Ritual Caster
ritual_caster.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. You learn the ritual spells of level 1 the game knows and cast them as rituals, without a slot, outside a fight.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. A foe beside you who Disengages, or strikes someone other than you, invites your reaction blow. A creature you hit with an opportunity attack stops where it is.

shadow_touched.name: Shadow Touched
shadow_touched.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. The shadows teach you Invisibility and one level 1 spell of illusion or necromancy, each cast once a long rest without a slot (Invisibility comes with a later expansion).

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.text: +1 Dexterity. Your shots ignore half and three-quarters cover, a foe beside you does not spoil them, and long range costs you no disadvantage.

shield_master.name: Shield Master
shield_master.text: +1 Strength. Once a turn, after a melee hit, your shield bashes the foe: 5 feet back or down to the ground (a Strength save). When a spell or breath lets you save for half, a good Dexterity save behind your shield takes nothing.

skill_expert.name: Skill Expert
skill_expert.text: +1 to any ability, proficiency in one skill, and expertise (double proficiency) in one skill you are proficient in.

skulker.name: Skulker
skulker.text: +1 Dexterity. You sense what is within 10 feet without seeing it, hide in the confusion of a fight with advantage, and a missed shot does not give away where you hide.

slasher.name: Slasher
slasher.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Once a turn a slashing hit hamstrings the foe (10 feet slower until your next turn). A slashing critical hit leaves them unsteady: disadvantage on their attacks until your next turn.

speedy.name: Speedy
speedy.text: +1 Dexterity or Constitution. 10 feet faster; a Dash ignores rough ground; blows struck at you as you break away have disadvantage.

spell_sniper.name: Spell Sniper
spell_sniper.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Your spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, a foe beside you does not spoil them, and spells with an attack roll that reach 10 feet or more reach 60 feet further.

telekinetic.name: Telekinetic
telekinetic.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. As a bonus action your mind shoves a creature within 30 feet 5 feet (a Strength save). (Mage Hand comes with a later expansion.)

telepathic.name: Telepathic
telepathic.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. You speak mind to mind with anyone within 60 feet who shares a tongue with you, and can read surface thoughts once a day (Detect Thoughts comes with a later expansion).

war_caster.name: War Caster
war_caster.text: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Advantage on saves to keep a spell going; you cast with weapon and shield in hand; a foe who breaks away from you can be answered with a harmful cantrip instead of a blow.

weapon_master.name: Weapon Master
weapon_master.text: +1 Strength or Dexterity, and the trick (mastery) of one more kind of weapon you are proficient with; it may be changed after a long rest.

blind_fighting.name: Blind Fighting
blind_fighting.text: You sense everything within 10 feet of you, seen or not: darkness, fog and the invisible do not hide them from you.

dueling.name: Dueling
dueling.text: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon in hand.

great_weapon_fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
great_weapon_fighting.text: With a melee weapon held in both hands, a 1 or 2 on a damage die counts as a 3.

interception.name: Interception
interception.text: With a shield or a weapon in hand, your reaction turns aside a blow that hits a friend beside you: 1d10 + your proficiency bonus less damage.

protection.name: Protection
protection.text: With a shield, your reaction puts it in the way of an attack on a friend beside you: that attack and the rest against them have disadvantage until your next turn.

thrown_weapon_fighting.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
thrown_weapon_fighting.text: +2 damage when you hit with a thrown weapon.

two_weapon_fighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
two_weapon_fighting.text: Your off-hand blow adds your ability modifier to its damage.

unarmed_fighting.name: Unarmed Fighting
unarmed_fighting.text: Your fists hit for 1d6 + Strength (1d8 with no weapon or shield in hand), and anyone you hold takes 1d4 at the start of your turn.
